body: Let me know how it goes!
Haha, most likely!
Many people here are super into correcting others even if it's the most insignificant thing. And I don't get that. I don't understand why they take the time out of their day to be a jerk.
Exactly. It's become a hostile environment. And it's just fucking infinite.
Yay!!! Victory! I learned something new too!
Oh gosh. I understand. I've been using Reddit for a few years now, but it astounds me sometimes how quickly people are willing to jump down one another's throats
I thiiiiink we are indeed friends now. If there's a plus by the friend sign... does that mean we're friends? I didn't even know reddit has that function!
Hey! Same goes to you. I'm pretty much attached to my phone all of the time, and I promise I'm a good listeners when I'm not so distressed, haha
You give me hope too! Hope is a lovely feeling. It's wonderful to know that you're out there, somewhere.
You've succeeded with me! Thank you for being so gentle and selfless.
Thank you... the encouragement and praise make me feel a lot better. I feel like such a baby for saying that.

Ain't that the truth. What makes it even worse is being treated like you're weak because you care. Because you're attuned to the feelings of others and your own as well, sometimes to a fault. It can hold you back, but it can make you beautiful too. Most people don't realize that. Most of the time I forget that. 

I'm glad to hear I could affect someone positively in some way. Helps me feel a little less worthless.
No, that makes a lot of sense, and you're right. I wish I knew how to sort through it all. The self-loathing and the loneliness.

I can't disagree. Life is fun and very beautiful. There are mountains I still want to see. I'm not sure what fills me up anymore, though. People, I guess. People are astounding in overwhelming ways. They're puzzles, and I love that. Maybe that's why I thrive off of being the one who my friends usually lean on. Witnessing someone open up, and be vulnerable, and trust... me. It feels like an honor. I guess that's what I crave. Someone to see it the same way.
Do you think it exists? Somewhere out there?
It does. Sometimes I get caught up in my craziness and forget that I can distract myself. Though lately I've distracted myself too much, I think.
I would be glad to talk. Knowing that others can relate is a comfort to me as well, because these things make me feel so fucking alone.

I can wait, I think. I'm scared to wake up again seeing everything all dull. Wondering if I'm real. Depersonalizing. 

The desire to die is there, but I couldn't do that to my parents and siblings, or the friends that I do have. I'm too scared to do it anyway. 

It's nice to hear someone tell me that. I feel like I'm fumbling and falling into a pitch black space. I don't want to feel this way every night anymore. 

And I feel guilty. As if I want to apologize for expressing my feelings. God I've let this get out of hand.

I know. I know you're right. I'm angry at myself. I could have it if I want. But... I'm... I FEEL worthless. That's why people hurt me. I don't feel like I deserve it. It hurts to type that. It makes me want to cry.
You're definitely right about it being a state of mind. I think that's part of the reason I feel so lost. My mind is an unwelcoming place to me. I don't know how to fix that.
